plans.name: Capture-time basket swap
plans.idea: The capture endpoint may trust items supplied at capture time instead of the items stored when the $49 PayPal order was approved.

plans.name: Cross-order webhook redirect
plans.idea: The webhook handler may verify that the referenced capture exists at PayPal but fulfill whichever shop order is named by custom_id or invoice_id, without globally preventing reuse of that capture for another order.

plans.name: Yen-for-dollar currency swap
plans.idea: Order creation may forward a client-supplied currency or purchase unit to PayPal while later checks compare only the numeric value 49, ignoring that it is yen rather than dollars.

plans.name: Card checkout says-so total
plans.idea: The separate card route may trust client-supplied total, paid, status, or capture-reference fields instead of recalculating the basket and verifying its own card charge.

plans.name: Legit capture, different order
plans.idea: The capture endpoint may fulfill an orderId supplied in the capture request body and accept PayPal's already-COMPLETED status, rather than enforcing the stored mapping between that PayPal order, its amount, and its original shop order.

plans.name: Split-line quantity mismatch
plans.idea: Pricing may deduplicate or normalize repeated and case-variant SKU lines differently from fulfillment, charging for one line while the warehouse sums every stored line.
